label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is encodeForHTML(sql) written to response.getWriter(); HTML encoding is applied at the response sink, neutralizing XSS. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar = param (user input from request header): in doSomething(), param is added to valuesList at index 1, then valuesList.get(1) retrieves that same user-controlled value, which flows into the SQL query string at line 56 without parameterization. The SQL injection vulnerability is real because user input reaches the database query unsafely.

evidence.note: In doSomething(): param added to valuesList[1], then valuesList.get(1) retrieves user-controlled param as bar
User-controlled bar flows into SQL query string at line 56 without parameterization; encodeForHTML at line 60 only affects response output, not database query
